title: Unit Event — Chase My Ideal Idol!

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! receives an offer to appear at Idol Lovers Festival, the big break for many young idol groups. During rehearsals, Airi is shocked by the performance of another group...

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
Our meeting for that show went pretty well. It's really going to be our first time appearing as regulars.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
But I was sooo nervous the whole time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're always nervous, but today was on a different level. You were as stiff as a robot before we'd even entered the building...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The gate at the entrance even closed on you. But I guess it is like you to mix up your entry ID with your commuter pass...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad that you were able to get in after realizing what you'd done.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry about what happened back there!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Hehe. I know you were nervous, but I'm really glad that our meeting went as well as it did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, everything went perfectly!
And it was so easy to talk about stuff since we'd worked with the director before on a different show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The producer we got to meet for the first time also seemed like a very nice person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. They even took the time to ask us all about what kind of message we were hoping to send.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know this was just a chance for us to meet everyone, but I'm really looking forward to how things are going to turn out.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Me too. I have a feeling that you're all going to do really well on this program!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, I just remembered.
There's another matter that I'd like to discuss with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Another matter?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes. So, I received an offer regarding a live stage performance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A live stage performance...?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, for an outdoor music event called the “Idol Lovers Festival.” You may or may not have—

rows.Speaker: Airi & Minori
rows.Line: Idol Lovers?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ah, so you are familiar with it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to think that every idol would be.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and not just idols. Fans of idols as well. It's famous for being like a rite of passage for young idol groups.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Right. And those who do well at this festival tend to become very successful.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The media, music producers, agency scouts and countless others from the industry are usually present. As a result, this event has become a very big deal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, this is Idol Lovers we're talking about.
You can't just sign up and perform there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You usually need a certain amount of experience and name recognition in order to receive an invite...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, and this offer is no exception.
In other words...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: They've decided to invite MORE MORE JUMP! because you've all been able to build up a good track record.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, we have...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-This is incredible...!
We've really been invited to perform at Idol Lovers...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, does this mean the festival's operators have been watching what we've been doing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The channel it airs on requires a subscription, but it is aired live on TV every year.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They even make it available online for a few weeks afterward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This festival is a great chance for us to reach even more new people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, it'd be really hard to put on shows right now because of scheduling and budgeting issues.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if we're being invited to perform at Idol Lovers, then we don't have to worry about any of those things.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Our fans are going to be so excited!
A lot of them have been commenting on our streams about how much they want another show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
True.
When you put it that way, there's no reason for us to not accept.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh...
Sorry, I didn't mean to space out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The truth is, I've been wanting to perform at Idol Lovers since when I was still with QT...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I'm sorta having a hard time believing that we've been invited.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I think we have our answer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna go on that stage and give it absolutely everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In that case, I'll let them know that you accept their invitation!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, we gotta start working on our set list and dances for it today!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
There's actually one more thing I need to mention...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One more thing?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, it has to do with the festival's special ensemble.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, the thing they do every year!
You always get to see different groups perform and interact with one another!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, this has apparently involved everything from dance battles to eating competitions.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But this year, they'll be pairing up two different groups to do a joint performance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A joint performance...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean we get to perform with another group?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: W-What kind of group will we be paired with...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Nothing has been set in stone yet, but the name that's been brought up is...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: A group called “ReLight”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ReLight...? Aren't they...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The group that has Mr. Hiiragi as their producer. The same person that helped build ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They've been appearing on TV and in magazines a ton lately!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've watched them a few times on TV too.
They're really amazing singers and their dancing is impeccable...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't help but keep thinking about how did they learn to dance like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've been hearing their name more often recently, but I didn't realize they were that good!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And to think that we may get to perform with them on stage? This is so exciting, and such an honor.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
In terms of popularity, you really can't ask for more...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something concerning you?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, not concerning per se...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But despite ReLight's popularity, they've been receiving a lot of nasty comments on social media.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I've also noticed that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I remember one person saying, “They aren't good. They just have a big agency backing them.” Another even said, “They're all rotten on the inside.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What?!
They've never given off that impression on TV or in any magazine interview.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't really say what their personalities are like, but I totally get why they're so popular right now! I mean, they really are amazing at singing and dancing!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Right. Those are all just rumors anyway, so it's nothing to dwell on...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But since there's a chance that you'll be performing alongside them, I thought it'd be good to at least be aware of this sort of thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We appreciate you being so careful and attentive, but I'm sure we'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Because our goal remains unchanged.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right! We're gonna go to Idol Lovers and give everyone the best performance we possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
You're all absolutely right!
I apologize for being so paranoid!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It is true that ReLight has been putting on incredible performances, so I'm sure this festival should end up being a good learning experience for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (A good learning experience...)

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
So, please do your best!
I promise to give you all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yeah, when it comes to idols, ReLight has recently started standing head and shoulders above the rest...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And being asked to perform with them means that the spotlight's going to be on our abilities...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As a singer, as a dancer and as a variety show star! I'm gonna keep evolving and become a super idol who can do it all!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This might be my chance to make what I said back then come true.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In order to make our joint performance with them a success...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And to put on the perfect show, I have to do my absolute best!)
A few weeks later
Joint Rehearsal Venue

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is where we're having our joint rehearsal?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess these are all the idols who are going to be performing at Idol Lovers...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So many in one place. This is incredible.
I'm even seeing some faces that I recognize from TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-So many famous idols in one spot... I-Is it really okay for someone like me to be here...?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: But you're a famous idol in your own right now, too, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I think I'm in the same boat as her this time around. Seeing all these established groups in one place is pretty overwhelming.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
They each have a distinct aura to them, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Mr. Hiiragi's over there...
I think I'll go say hi to him.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we all take this opportunity to go over and greet him?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
Greet him?! But he's the producer that made ASRUN!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What am I supposed to say...?! Should I start by thanking him for turning Haruka Kiritani into a super idol...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wouldn't based on why you're here right now. You'd probably really confuse him if you did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I want to introduce all of you to him, so let's go over.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, Mr. Hiiragi.
It's been quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Kiritani? It has been a while...
I'm glad to see that you're doing well.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I never thought that my group would end up performing with your new group like this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me neither.
This wasn't quite how I expected us to meet again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, I'd like to take this opportunity to introduce you to everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-N-Nice to meet you...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Haruka's told us all about you, Mr. Hiiragi.
We're looking forward to working with you very much.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Thank you for taking the time to do this.
I also look forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Also, Mr. Hiiragi...
There's something I've been meaning to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know I ended up causing you a lot of trouble after I made my decision to leave ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But everything you taught me when I was still a member has had a big impact on my life. Even now, your knowledge serves as a guide for my work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really can't thank you enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I see you're still as polite as ever.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
But you don't need to thank me.
After all, you're no longer a member of ASRUN. Now, you're Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
But we really are looking forward to working with you on this performance.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, if it's possible, we'd like to greet everyone from ReLight as well...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Oh, in that case...
Wow, it really is MORE MORE JUMP! Nice to meet you!
se_run_women_002_1

I watch your streams all the time!
Also, I was so moved by the way you made those bookmarks for everyone on “The Town Revitalization Team!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Y-You're...!
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

Slow down, Akari.
You haven't even introduced yourself yet.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
I'm Chiharu Tsubaki from ReLight. This is Yu Hagiyama.

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: And Miss Sunshine here is...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Oh, I'm Akari Enosaki!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Sorry if I startled you guys.
I just got so excited after seeing that you're really here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's them...
It's really ReLight...!

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line: So, there's actually four more of us, but they're all getting ready somewhere else.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Mr. Hiiragi?
We have that meeting soon and...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Oh, is it that time already?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Sorry, but you'll have to excuse me here.
Be on your best behavior, Enosaki.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Oh... Sir, yessir...!
Take care, Mr. Producer!
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They seem pretty nice as far as I can tell.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I guess those rumors about their agency doing all the heavy lifting and them not having the best personalities were just that. Rumors.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for coming over to introduce yourselves. Also, we weren't sure you'd recognize us...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Of course we recognize you!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Also, please stop being so formal!
You're our seniors when it comes to being idols!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Seniors?! No, but...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'd like to keep things friendly as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Incidentally, we were just talking about how we stand to learn a lot from such a famous group.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're all so good at singing and dancing...!
I get so excited every time I see you on TV!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Our performances get you that excited...?

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Thank you for saying that!
That's actually what we're going for as idols!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Everyone, including our producer, has been saying how we still need a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: But we want to become idols who can make people all across Japan smile through our singing and dancing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All across Japan...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: We've been putting a ton of effort into our singing and dancing, so we couldn't be happier to hear MORE MORE JUMP! praise us like this since you're basically our heroes!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: We believe that we have a lot to learn from you as well. We're really looking forward to performing with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, likewise.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Through their singing and dancing...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That sounds like us...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
Would everyone from ReLight please join us on the stage? We'd like to do a quick run from the top!

rows.Speaker: Yu
rows.Line: Oh, that's us.

rows.Speaker: Chiharu
rows.Line:
Right, we're up first.
Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Please watch if you have time!
We promise to do everything we can to make our joint performance the best show ever!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, we will.
Break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't know ReLight would be taking the stage first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me neither. I know this is just a rehearsal and not the real thing, but I'd be so nervous if I were them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
My heart would probably explode if I were in their shoes...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, they're starting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Their expressions...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: W-Wow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, the expressions on their faces when they started... It's hard to believe that they're the same people we just talked to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's like they were able to pull everyone into their world the second they took the stage...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've seen them perform on TV many times before...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But this is unreal.
I can't take my eyes off them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I can't believe they're able to do this live...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Everyone's totally awestruck.
The way they're making eye contact with the audience and using their fingers...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The expressions they're making match the lyrics so well. No, it's not just that... Everything they're doing is perfect.)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Everyone, including our producer, has been saying how we still need a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Who can say that they still need a lot of work...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They're idols through and through...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Exactly like the ones I looked up to since I was little.)
A few hours later
Joint Rehearsal Venue

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Nice performance!
Let's take a brief break here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Was such an amazing performance...!
How awesome was ReLight?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Incredible! They sang three songs, but it was over before we knew it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Despite going first, they ended up leaving the biggest impression on everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The other groups are all really good, but they definitely stood out the most.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
We really can't ask for a better performance partner.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm gonna go grab some water.
Are any of you thirsty?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: U-Umm... I'm okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll be right back!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Phew...
Some cold water was just what I needed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna be moving around a lot after this, so I need to stay hydrated.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Still...
ReLight totally blew the roof off this place.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Haruka was right.
A bunch of groups performed after ReLight, but they ended up leaving the biggest impression.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We really can't ask for a better collaboration partner, but the thought of having to dance next to them is starting to feel like a scary prospect...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Performing alongside ReLight is a good opportunity for us to improve our singing and dancing skills... But it doesn't look like it's going to be an easy feat.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (What should we do...?)

rows.Speaker: Idols
rows.Line:
ReLight leading off Idol Lovers.
It's so obvious that they're getting special treatment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Idols
rows.Line: I guess that's what happens when you have a famous producer backing you. I mean, they went from zeroes to heroes in seconds. Someone at their agency is definitely the puppet master.

rows.Speaker: Idols
rows.Line: When you put it that way, is there even any point in trying? Ugh, now I really wish I had joined a different agency.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(How can they say that?
Were they not looking at the stage just now?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (There's no way you can put on a performance like that unless you put in the work and effort. They should know that!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(I can't let this slide.
I have to say something.)

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: It's okay, Momoi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: E-Enosaki...?!

rows.Speaker: Idols
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?
Enosaki's here?

rows.Speaker: Idols
rows.Line: We need to leave.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: No, I should be the one apologizing to you! I feel awful about you hearing those rumors about us.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Also, Momoi, it looked like you were about to go and say something to them... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, you don't need to thank me.
I just got so irritated at what they said.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
But that made me really happy!
It's so nice to know that you'd defend us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, are you sure about this?
They said some really awful things just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Regular people spreading around those kinds of rumors is one thing, but we're talking about people in the industry here. Aren't you worried that it's gonna affect your work...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Yeah, we are...
And we had a lot of trouble coming to terms with it when it first started happening.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! hasn't acted this way, but whenever we collaborate with other groups, they often tend to be wary of working with us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: But our producer told us to not lose sight of our goal.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: He said, “You will encounter naysayers along the way as you strive to become top idols.”

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
“So, don't give them any heed.
You don't even have to try to shake them off.”

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: “But someday...”

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: “You're going to show them by spreading or inspiring hope in them.”

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: After hearing that, we were completely on board.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: He's right about us still having a lot of work to do and how we aren't able to reach many people yet. That's on top of all the comments and criticism we get...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
But we only have one goal.
To keep spreading as much hope as we can to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: As long as we focus on that, I'm sure people will start understanding what we're trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Enosaki...

rows.Speaker: ReLight Member
rows.Line:
Akari!
Do you have a minute? I wanna make sure we have that one part down.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Just a minute!
Be right there!

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line: Sorry, Momoi, I didn't mean to make you spend your break talking about something so gloomy...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, don't worry about that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, you gave me a really valuable piece of information. Good luck with that part by the way.

rows.Speaker: Akari
rows.Line:
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Line: (These are movements where I can apply the techniques I've cultivated so far. I need to make the most of this chance to learn!)

rows.Line: It's wonderful how your poses feel fun and energetic, but try to use your whole body to exude a more elegant impression.

rows.Line: The position of your limbs is important, but so are their angles. This helps lead the viewer's eye to where you want them to look. Let's try it together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Even if I copied her exactly, there's no way the current me would be able to achieve the same result...)

rows.Speaker: Minori

rows.Line: So, please! Could we try that again?

rows.Line: Your goal is to become an idol who can do it all, right? Someone who can sing, dance and is great at speaking. A super idol.

rows.Line: Yes. As far as becoming this “ideal idol” is concerned, you've raised the bar quite high...

rows.Line: For example, I avoided trying to perform like Haruka and Shizuku because I thought it'd be too difficult... As a result, I neglected acquiring those skills.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Also...

rows.Line: I realized that I'd been wasting so much time by avoiding things that I felt didn't suit me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
